PLUS ULTRA: Surge.name: PLUS ULTRA: Surge
PLUS ULTRA: Surge.description:
💥 PLUS ULTRA! You went past your limit at the edge of a fight.

📈 For two turns: Quirk Output +25, Quirk Control +20, Striking +20, Willpower +15
⚠️ Then the cost lands: Overexerted.
PLUS ULTRA: Surge.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is in a Plus Ultra surge: past their limit for a short burst. Their Quirk hits harder than it ever has and they keep going on will alone, while the Drawback shows in full. It is a moment, not a new power: nothing their Quirk cannot do.
